name: Calendly

agent.name: Howie
does: Schedules meetings over email and text threads
Follows up when people go quiet
Protects focus time and flags conflicts

whatYouLose: A self-serve booking page as the main flow
Works with Gmail and Google Calendar; Outlook support isn't listed
notes: Howie acts like an assistant you CC, so nobody has to click a link. For small teams that schedule over email, it covers what Calendly does and more.
